_doc: Case-bank papers: identity (first author, title fragment, DOIs) and the claim pair used in notices. Search terms are NOT hand-written any more (removed 2026-10-03): citations.targets derives them from the drift event's claim_diffs like for every other paper.

r0_preliminary_ijid.title_fragment: Preliminary estimation of the basic reproduction number

drift.preprint_v1_claim: mean incubation period 5.8 days (95% CI 4.6-7.9), from 34 cases
drift.current_claim: mean incubation period 6.4 days (95% CrI 5.6-7.7), from 88 cases

guan_nejm_clinical.title_fragment: Clinical characteristics of 2019 novel coronavirus infection

drift.preprint_v1_claim: median incubation period 3.0 days (range 0 to 24.0 days)
drift.current_claim: median incubation period 4 days (interquartile range 2 to 7); the 24-day maximum does not appear in the published paper

drift.preprint_v1_claim: 75 patients (50.7%) showed abnormal liver function at admission
drift.current_claim: 55 patients (37.2%) had abnormal liver function (now explicitly defined)

epi_characteristics_jcm.title_fragment: Incubation Period and Other Epidemiological Characteristics

drift.preprint_v1_claim: incubation period 2 to 9 days (95% range); quarantine of at least nine days
drift.current_claim: incubation period 2-14 days; quarantine of at least 14 days

ethiopia_vaccination.title_fragment: Childhood vaccination coverage and equity impact in Ethiopia

drift.preprint_v1_claim: national coverage for BASIC vaccination 39.7% (2016 EDHS)
drift.current_claim: FULL vaccination coverage 33.3%; basic vaccination reported as 38.5%

forecasting_plosone.title_fragment: Data-based analysis, modelling and forecasting of the COVID-19

drift.preprint_v1_claim: under-reporting scenario of five times the infected and eight times the recovered; R0 about 2.5
drift.current_claim: scenario of twenty times infected and forty times recovered

kucharski_early_dynamics.title_fragment: Early dynamics of transmission and control

drift.preprint_v1_claim: 29,500 prevalent symptomatic cases in Wuhan on 23 January; R fluctuated between 1.6 and 2.9
drift.current_claim: prevalence estimate withdrawn; Rt declined from 2.35 to 1.05

vicarious_traumatization.title_fragment: Vicarious traumatization in the general public

drift.preprint_v1_claim: risk factors gender (OR 3.1717) and fertility (OR 2.072) for vicarious traumatization in non-front-line nurses
drift.current_claim: risk-factor regression removed from the paper
